(function(GVM) { 'use strict'; var typeChecks = GVM.utils.typeChecks; var safeTraverse = GVM.utils.safeTraverse; var objectWalker = {}; // Skip list - property names/objects known to cause issues var SKIP_KEYS = { '__GVM_LOADED__': true, '__GVM__': true, 'GVM': true, 'chrome': true, 'caches': true, 'cookieStore': true, 'serviceWorker': true, 'localStorage': true, 'sessionStorage': true, item.depth; if (depth > maxDepth) continue; if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') continue; try { if (visited.has(obj)) continue; visited.add(obj); } catch (e) { continue; } var keys =
